annotation.title_clean: The Medical Devices (Amendment etc.) (EU Exit) Regulations 2019
annotation.title_en: The Medical Devices (Amendment etc.) (EU Exit) Regulations 2019
annotation.authors_or_issuer: UK Secretary of State (Department of Health and Social Care); legislation.gov.uk
annotation.summary_en: UK statutory instrument amending the Medical Devices Regulations 2002 after Brexit. It replaces CE marking with UK marking, introduces approved bodies and UK responsible persons, creates device registration for Great Britain, and sets transitional recognition of EU CE-marked devices. No AI or robotics-specific provisions.
key_provisions_or_claims: Replaces CE marking with UK marking and notified bodies with approved bodies
Requires registration of manufacturers and UK responsible persons with the Secretary of State
Allows CE-marked devices to be placed on the GB market during transitional periods
Provides for designated standards and a public register of approved bodies
Recognises mutual recognition agreement countries (Australia, NZ, Canada, US, Switzerland)
